faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in West Godavari District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the post of Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class in West Godavari District Court Recruitment 2026. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for West Godavari District Court Special Judicial Magistrate posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the offline application form for the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class posts is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class posts in West Godavari District Court is offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and send the application form via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class posts must be between 45 and 65 years of age. Age relaxation details should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Law Degree and experience as a retired Judicial Officer, an Advocate with 5 years practice, or a retired Gazetted Officer with magisterial experience. Specific details are in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class post is Rs. 45,000/- per month, along with an additional Rs. 5,000/- for conveyance. This makes for an attractive compensation package.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for West Godavari District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the West Godavari District Court Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class recruitment. This is beneficial for all applicants.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class posts includes application scrutiny, followed by a written test or an interview, or both. Candidates should prepare accordingly for these stages.

faq.question: Q9. How can I download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form from the official website of West Godavari District Court. It is crucial to read the official notification first to understand the application procedure and requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class posts will be posted in various locations within the West Godavari District, including Eluru, Kovvur, Tanuku, Palakol, and Jangareddigudem, as per the vacancy details.
